rules.source: Law 125(I)/2018 providing for the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data — copy of the statute https://www.cut.ac.cy/digitalAssets/472/472580_1law125_i_2018.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Section 8 (University of Cyprus copy of the statute): processing of personal data is lawful where information society services are offered directly to a child and the child is at least fourteen years old; for a child younger than fourteen, processing is lawful only when consent is given or authorised by the holder of parental responsibility. The regulator is the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection; later amendment 26(I)/2022 not checked.

rules.source: Law 22(III)/2004 ratifying the Budapest Convention on Cybercrime; Law 147(I)/2015 (attacks against information systems) — Council of Europe Octopus profile https://rm.coe.int/octocom-legal-profile-cyprus/16809e5a34
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe profile lists L.22(III)/2004, including Art. 48 (offences against the confidentiality, integrity and availability of computer data systems) and the computer-related offences; one secondary source says Law 147(I)/2015 implements Directive 2013/40/EU (unconfirmed). Ratification dates differ between sources (WIPO: ratified 19 January 2005).

rules.source: Consumer Protection Law 2021, Law 112(I)/2021 — Better Internet for Kids https://better-internet-for-kids.europa.eu/en/rules-guidelines/consumer-protection-law-2021-law-112i2021
rules.retrieved_snippet: Consolidated and modernised Cypriot consumer protection law aligned with EU law; prohibits unfair commercial practices (misleading and aggressive practices that materially distort consumer behaviour); the Consumer Protection Service within the Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry enforces it; secondary sources differ on the wording of the unfairness test. Statute text not retrieved.
